Learning for Vision-Language Models

Abstract
Federated prompt learning (FPL) for vision-
language models is a powerful approach to collab-
oratively adapt models across distributed clients
while preserving data privacy. However, exist-
ing FPL approaches suffer from a trade-off be-
tween performance and robustness, particularly
in out-of-distribution (OOD) shifts, limiting their
reliability
